About.EhentaiViewDesc: EhentaiView is not affiliated with E-hentai.org in any way
SignIn.info: Native apps (EhViewer, JHenTai) log in inside an in-app WebView so Cloudflare Turnstile stays on forums.e-hentai.org and the app can read cookies. This web app runs in your browser at localhost — it cannot capture those cookies the same way. Use Browser login below (open forums, solve Turnstile, paste cookies). Password login may work when FlareSolverr can clear Cloudflare.

Search.Short: The search string is too short, and was ignored.
verticalMaxHeightHint: Caps each page to a fraction of the screen so tall images fit better on phones.
EH.IframeUnavailable: The gallery site cannot be embedded here (browsers block third-party cookies, which caused a redirect loop). Open it in a new tab; copy your cookies from User Cookie if you need to sign in there.
List.JumpTooFar: Jump is limited to 50 pages ahead (site uses cursors, not page numbers).
List.JumpInvalid: Enter a page number of 1 or greater.
History.DoNotStore.Hint: When on, browsing galleries and reading pages will not write to Histories or read-position storage. Existing entries stay until you clear them.
UiTheme.classic.Hint: Original Material UI look for list and search chrome.
UiTheme.v3.Hint: Seed-based viewfinder pager and Filter Deck chrome.
UiTheme.v4.Hint: Cyberpunk violet and gold chrome (current default).
SignIn.CookieHint: 1) Open forums login. 2) Solve Cloudflare and sign in. 3) DevTools → Application → Cookies for e-hentai.org / exhentai.org. 4) Paste a dump or fill the fields. Secrets stay on this server as HttpOnly — never in localStorage.
SignIn.IgneousHint: Required for exhentai.org. Optional for e-hentai.org. Obtained when you visit exhentai after a valid session.
EhvSite.exhentai.Hint: Requires Sign In with igneous. Sad panda if cookies are missing.
EhvSite.NeedLogin: Sign in first before switching to exhentai.org
EhvSite.NeedIgneous: Missing or invalid igneous. Sign in again, or use Advanced cookie login with igneous included.
Download.Empty: No downloads yet. Open a gallery and tap Download.
Download.ShowNav.Hint: When off, the Downloads tab is hidden from the bottom and desktop nav. The Downloads page remains reachable from Settings.
Download.ClearAll.Hint: Delete all locally saved galleries from this server.
Download.ClearAll.Confirm: Delete all downloaded galleries from this device/server?
Cache.Clear.Hint: Flush the server gallery cache and the in-app SWR cache.
SignIn.AdvancedCookieHint: Use if password login fails (Cloudflare/captcha). Copy ipb_member_id, ipb_pass_hash, and (for ExHentai) igneous after signing in on e-hentai/exhentai.
SignIn.CookieDumpHint: Paste a full Cookie header or DevTools lines containing ipb_member_id and ipb_pass_hash (igneous optional). Fields below fill automatically.
SignIn.CookieDumpInvalid: Could not find both ipb_member_id and ipb_pass_hash in the paste.
SignIn.BrowserLoginHint: Same idea as EhViewer/JHenTai WebView login: you solve Turnstile in a real browser tab. Then paste cookies here — localhost cannot read forums cookies automatically (no WebView CookieManager).
SignIn.PasswordFallbackHint: Server posts to forums via FlareSolverr when configured. Often blocked by interactive Turnstile — use Browser login instead.
SignIn.LanAccessHint: Opened from the network ({{url}}). Sign in on this device — cookies from localhost are not shared. On phones, paste cookies here (Chrome extension is desktop-only).
